## F — Consolidated VERIFY list

Open verification items for this section's dossier (cancellation, revocation, suspension and the point system):
- sec03-A-EFFECTIVE-DATE — the manual prints its edition (November 2024, front cover) but no effective date.
- sec03-A-SCORING — question count, passing score and time limit not stated in the manual.
- sec03-A-FORMAT — knowledge test item format not described beyond automated delivery.
- sec03-D-FLAG — Point-system pages extract with a duplicated text layer and fragmentary sentences.
- AL-SEC-THREE-E-MARKET — market signal and competitor teardown not researched.
- sec03-G-PASSING — passing standard exactness cannot be met from the manual.
- sec03-G-MARKET — teardown and market pack boxes await sourced recon.
Every other fact in C and C2 of this section is page-cited with high confidence and carries no open debt.
